content:
Consider the following when conﬁguring SAML authentication:
• Signed and encrypted requests are not supported.
• Encrypted assertions are not supported.
• IdP-initiated authentication and sign-out are not supported.
• Service Control Policies (SCP) will not be applicable or evaluated in the case of non-IAM identities
(like SAML in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless & SAML and basic internal user authorization for
Amazon OpenSearch Service).
